# Objective

pr_comments: @cBournhonesque can you amend your commit message to do that? Edit the commit message, and then force push. See https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors for the incantation.
I think I managed to update the authors in the commit; however a Macos tests fails for some reason? It doesn't use AnyOf
Something went wrong with the last rebase. Seeing changes in this pr that are unrelated.

issue_context.title: `AnyOf` can violate single mutable alias rule

review_comments:
Can you add tests for:

1. `&mut A` + `&A`
2.  `&A + &mut A` 
3. `&mut A` + Option<&A>`
4. `Entity` + `&mut A`
5. `() + &mut A`

as well? This is substantially trickier than I anticipated and I want to be sure all of our bases are covered as we refactor.
